mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical inverse relationship between FEDFUNDS level and SPX returns
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% is negative or not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.0% indicates economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical correlation between high unemployment and negative equity returns
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when UNRATE > 5.0% is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS above 0.5% and CPIAUCSL above 225 indicates a monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 225 is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), compressed equity valuations produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A PAYEMS level above 130000 supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to stronger economic growth.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical positive correlation between employment growth and equity returns
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when PAYEMS > 130000 is negative or not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST level above 500 thousand units indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical positive correlation between housing starts and equity returns
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when HOUST > 500 is negative or not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO is above 90 and GDPC1 is above 13000, it indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when INDPRO > 90 and GDPC1 > 13000 is negative or not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 90), reduced economic activity produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when INDPRO < 90 is positive or not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
